symptom: A Design snapshot requested after a watcher-observed agent save could join an in-flight read that began before the save, so the canvas showed the older aggregate until the next event.
rule: Share an in-flight snapshot read only within the change epoch it started in; the watcher fences the checkout when it observes a raw change, before its debounce. See engine/design/snapshot-epoch.ts.
check: pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/engine/workspace/__tests__/service.test.ts -t "observed source change" && pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/engine/git/__tests__/watch.test.ts -t "fences in-flight"
